Koyal N1 is a fun and educational palm-sized drone designed for school students to explore the basics of flight, coding, and STEM. Easy to control, safe to fly indoors, and perfect for hands-on learning and school projects.

Key Features

Auto-Rotating Primary Camera

Elevate your drone photography with a camera that rotates automatically, giving students and creators greater control over framing shots without manually repositioning the drone.

HD Dual Cameras

Capture every detail with front and bottom HD cameras. The dual-camera system enables aerial photography, optical flow stabilisation, and richer in-flight awareness for students exploring drone technology.
LED Landing Lights
Safe touchdowns in low light conditions. Integrated LED landing lights improve visibility during dim-light flying sessions, making the Koyal N1 a practical tool for school labs, auditoriums, and indoor STEM events.

360° Flip Stunts

Perform exciting 360° flips with a single button. A favourite feature for students, the one-touch flip function introduces the physics of aerobatic manoeuvres in a fun, accessible way — perfect for classroom demos and competitions.
